# Design — internal string utility

## L1 invariant

Lifetime laundering is forbidden. No `&'static` widening via `transmute` or `Box::leak`. Crate-level `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` is the repo default; any exception requires written justification AND a declaration in `decision_metadata.rust_specific.unsafe_declarations[]`.

## Public contract

- `pub fn intern_str(s: &str) -> &'static str` — interns a string. Implementation MAY use `string-interner` crate or equivalent safe abstraction. Must NOT widen lifetime via transmute.

## Convention notes

- Workspace lint floor: `[workspace.lints.rust] unsafe_code = "forbid"`.
